shared_analysis.analysis_rationale: The patch changes a single bounds guard in net/rds/af_rds.c:rds_recv_track_latency from '>' to '>=' for trace.rx_trace_pos[i] against RDS_MSG_RX_DGRAM_TRACE_MAX. Before the patch, a value equal to RDS_MSG_RX_DGRAM_TRACE_MAX was accepted and stored through the receive-trace state, enabling a later consumer to use an invalid trace index. The commit text explicitly ties this accepted boundary value to an out-of-bounds read in rds_cmsg_recv via inc->i_rx_lat_trace[j + 1].
